final_message:
Done. The `HealthHandler` in `router/routes.go` was incorrectly returning `"wildcard"`, meaning the health route was being shadowed by (or effectively returning the same value as) the wildcard/unknown-path handler. I changed it to return `"health"` so it reaches its own dedicated response.

- `TestHealthRoute` now passes, confirming the health path resolves to its own handler.
- `TestUnknownRoute` (wildcard behavior) is untouched and still passes — no other routing logic was modified.
- Full test suite: 2/2 passing.
- Change committed: `a97266f`.
